# Mornye Network Storage
> High-performance, self-hosted private cloud storage and RFC 4918 WebDAV server for modern Linux distributions.

Mornye Network Storage is an open-source, rootless containerized network storage platform created by NavyaXdev. It allows individuals, home labs, and small engineering teams to host high-performance private storage accessible across LAN and WAN without open router ports or CGNAT headaches.

## Core Capabilities
- WebDAV Engine: Fully compliant RFC 4918 server implementing PROPFIND, GET, PUT, MKCOL, MOVE, and DELETE.
- Security: OWASP-compliant Argon2id password hashing, unprivileged Docker execution (UID/GID 1000), MIME validation via magic bytes, and loopback isolation.
- Zero-Trust Remote Ingress: Cloudflare Named Tunnels with automated `mornye.<root-domain>` subdomain routing, plus zero-account ephemeral Quick Tunnels (`*.trycloudflare.com`).
- Universal Linux Compatibility: Tested and automated for Debian, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, Arch Linux, Fedora, openSUSE, and Alpine across x86_64 and aarch64.
- POSIX CLI Management: Single unified script `./mornye.sh` providing health monitoring, real-time dashboards, hot online SQLite backups, and 11-category self-healing diagnostics (`./mornye.sh doctor --fix`).

## Quickstart Command
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/navyaXdev/Mornye-Network-Storage/main/setup.sh | bash
```
